description: Elections Commission - Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Order under Article 98(8) of the Constitution
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, certifying the number of members each electoral district is entitled to return based on the 2023 electoral registers. It is issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority (Article 98(8) of the Constitution) and contains a schedule listing electoral districts with their corresponding member allocations, making it clearly about election-related matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
